summary: Bio Green Med Solution filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement for the private placement of 1,103,338 common shares at $0.72 per share, raising $794,403 in gross proceeds. The transaction closed on June 10, 2026, and proceeds are earmarked for general corporate and working capital purposes. A concurrent registration rights agreement obligates the company to file a resale registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising event with no special-situations attributes—no tender offer, restructuring, spin-off, activist campaign, or strategic review—so it does not qualify for any special-situation category. Standard PIPE terms apply; investors were foreign accredited investors. No premium, advisor, or break fee is mentioned. Watch for the effectiveness of the resale registration statement.
